ImageDescription.value: These prayer bells at Wat Thepleela are rung by Buddhist devotees and other temple visitors, to bring good luck, good health and success in life. Over each one is a caption with a short description of the bell's significance. Wat Thepleela is located at Soi Ramkhamhaeng 39, Hua Mak, Bangkok, Thailand. It can be reached also with the Saen Saep canal ferry. The temple has the distinction of being a "Royal Temple", founded during the reign of King Rama III. In 2016, the engine of one of the Saen Saep canal ferries exploded at the Wat Thepleela pier, injuring 58 people.
